# Torrington Fasteners - nightly bin sync

One row per part in a bin, as written by the night stock sync in
write order. part_code is the exact catalogue code: FT-3306 is the
zinc hex bolt, FT-3306-B is the separate black-phosphate finish and
a different part. qty_on_hand is the counted quantity in that bin.
